zh.title: 美軍C-130H在愛爾蘭香農機場受損 美國聯邦檢方起訴一人
zh.summary: 美國聯邦檢方11月17日宣布，已就4月11日香農機場美軍運輸機受損案，以毀損政府財產罪名起訴一名愛爾蘭籍男子。
body: 美國紐約南區聯邦檢察官辦公室11月17日公布起訴消息。檢方指控一名愛爾蘭籍男子在4月11日毀損一架停在香農機場的美國空中國民兵C-130H運輸機。
檢方表示，這架運輸機受損後已無法再飛行。被告遭控毀損美國政府財產，在法院認定有罪前推定無罪。

en.title: U.S. charges man over damage to C-130H transport aircraft at Shannon Airport
en.summary: Federal prosecutors announced an indictment over an April 11 incident involving an Air National Guard transport aircraft parked at Shannon Airport.
body: The U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Southern District of New York announced on November 17 that an Irish national had been indicted in connection with damage to a U.S. Air National Guard C-130H parked at Ireland’s Shannon Airport on April 11.
Prosecutors say the aircraft cannot fly again. The defendant faces a charge of destruction of government property and is presumed innocent unless proven guilty.

facts.claim: U.S. federal prosecutors announced an indictment charging an Irish national with destruction of government property.
The case concerns an April 11 incident involving a U.S. Air National Guard C-130H parked at Shannon Airport.
The defendant is presumed innocent unless proven guilty.
